title: Lion's Loud and Quiet Day
lesson: Big feelings are okay: breathe, say sorry, and tell a friend
summary: Lion roars at Bunny when he feels cross, then learns with Owl to calm down with quiet roars and big breaths, and says sorry.

steps.say: One morning in the forest, Lion woke up feeling very cross.

steps.text: Grr! Everything is wrong today! Stomp, stomp, stomp!

steps.say: His ball rolled away. His tummy was grumbly. His mane was messy.
Along came Bunny, hop, hop, hop, with a big smile.

steps.text: Good morning, Lion! Do you want to play with me?
ROAR! No! Go away! I am cross!

steps.say: That was a very loud roar. Can you say ROAR loudly?

steps.text: Oh. Oh my. That was so loud.

steps.say: Bunny's ears drooped down. Her smile went away.
Now Lion was all alone. The forest was quiet. Very quiet.

steps.text: Hmm. Loud is not nice. Quiet is not nice. Oh dear.

steps.say: Whoosh! Owl flew down from the tall tree.

steps.text: Hoot, hoot. Lion, how do you feel inside?
I feel cross. Hot and fizzy, like a shaken bottle.
Cross is a big feeling. It is okay to feel cross.
But it is not okay to roar at a friend. Let us find a way.

steps.say: Lion took a little breath. He followed Owl to the beach.
At the beach, the sea went swish, swish, swish.

steps.text: Try a big, loud roar at the sea, Lion. Roar it all out!
ROAR! ROAR! ROAR!

steps.say: The big sea did not mind at all. Splash, splash!

steps.text: Now try the opposite. A tiny, quiet roar. Can you whisper roar with me?
Rrrr. Rrrr. Rrrr.

steps.say: Loud and quiet. Two opposites! Lion felt a little less fizzy.

steps.text: Loud makes me tired. Quiet makes me calm. I like quiet.
Here is another trick. A big breath in, and a slow breath out.

steps.say: Owl pointed to a pink balloon. Watch it grow, and grow!

steps.text: Breathe in. My tummy gets big, like the balloon.

steps.say: Now breathe out slowly. The balloon goes small.

steps.text: Breathe out. Whoosh. My tummy gets small.

steps.say: In is big. Out is small. Can you breathe in and out with Lion?

steps.text: Three big breaths. One, two, three. Now I feel soft inside.
You know what? Bunny was sad. Maybe we should say sorry.
Yes. I was loud and cross. I want to say sorry.

steps.say: In the garden, Bunny was counting flowers. She was very sad.

steps.text: One red flower. Two yellow flowers. Three pink flowers.

steps.say: Can you count the flowers with Bunny? One, two, three.
Then Lion came, slowly, slowly, with his head low.

steps.text: Oh. Hello, Lion.
Bunny, I am sorry I roared at you. I felt cross.
It was not your fault. Cross is a big feeling.
Thank you for saying sorry. I forgive you.

steps.say: Bunny's smile came back, big and bright.

steps.text: The flowers look thirsty. Shall we give them a drink?

steps.say: The flowers were dry. Lion and Bunny gave them a big drink.
Dry flowers drink water, and then they are wet. Dry and wet are opposites.

steps.text: Look! A new purple flower! Now we have four.

steps.say: One, two, three, four flowers. Can you count them?
Next they ran to the playground. The sun was bright and warm.

steps.text: Let us go up the slide, Lion! Up, up, up!
And then down, down, down! Up and down are opposites!

steps.say: Whee! Bunny and Lion slid down, fast, fast, fast.

steps.text: Now the swing. Fast, then slow. Fast, then slow.

steps.say: Fast and slow are opposites too. Can you swing fast? Now slow?
Owl flew over to watch them play.

steps.text: Lion, what will you do next time you feel cross?
First, stomp softly. Second, breathe in and out. Third, tell a friend.

steps.say: Can you remember? Stomp softly, breathe big and small, and tell a friend.

steps.text: And I will give you a big hug, Lion.

steps.say: They hugged, a warm and gentle hug. Lion felt happy and calm.
As the day grew late, the sun went down. The sky turned orange and pink.

steps.text: Today I was loud and cross. Then I was quiet and calm.
Big feelings come, and big feelings go. Just like the sun.
Hot and cold, big and small, loud and quiet. Today was full of opposites!

steps.say: Lion, Bunny and Owl watched the sunset together, nice and close.

steps.text: Roar... I mean, rrr. Goodnight, friends. See you tomorrow.

steps.say: The end!
